videos.title: The Bicep Curl That Wins the Ready Go (Super Curl Bar)
videos.summary:
Most armwrestlers think bicep training is only for hookers. I see it differently.

The way I curl on a super curl bar puts my hands close together and slightly pronated, which is almost exactly how my hand is set at the ready go. That means the strength I build in the gym carries straight to the table, right where matches are won or lost.

In this video I break down why this curl helps you hold the centre, start every match with your hand inside your shoulder, and build the wrist stability and static back pressure that turns into side pressure your opponent can't handle. Win the centre, win the ready go, and you're halfway to winning the match.

Give it a go on your next arm day and let me know how it feels in the comments.

Side pressure plus pronation is "God mode" in armwrestling. Out of the four fundamental strengths (wrist flexion, back pressure, pronation and side pressure), Ryan explains why side pressure and pronation are the most rewarding pair to dominate in, and why back pressure is NOT the best partner for your pronation.

In this video:
0:00 Side pressure + pronation = God mode
0:21 The four fundamental strengths of armwrestling
0:44 Why back pressure isn't the best combo with pronation

The key point: stopping the hook isn't enough. Without side pressure you'll never bring the match back to centre and finish it, no matter how much back pressure you have. Build your side pressure patiently, train it consistently every day without blowing up your elbows, and develop your pronation with absolute ferocity.
